import re

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data"
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_line_count(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("path")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+    segments = raw.split("/")
+    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in segments):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid path"}
+
+    target = DATA_DIR.joinpath(*segments)
+    if not target.is_file():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+
+    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    lines = text.count("\n")
+    if text and not text.endswith("\n"):
+        lines += 1
+    return 200, {"lines": lines}
